{{Top|leg}}
A '''datamemo''' was a format for transmitting written notes and instructions. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] of the [[Scimitar assault wing]] used a datamemo to relay information of the transfer of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from the [[Unidentified training squadron|training squadron]] from the [[Victorious (capital ship)|''Victorious'']] to the unit.
